subject: Q4 QBR prep: quick pulse — wins, risks, asks
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Exec Leadership <leadership-distro@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q4 QBR prep: quick pulse — wins, risks, asks

Team — sending a short pulse to capture items we should surface in Thursday's QBR. This is intentionally concise; if you have additions, reply inline.

Wins
- Hosted API latency improved by ~12% week-over-week after kernel tuning; user-facing latency SLO now at 95th pct = 120ms for our standard text-gen profile.
- Two mid-market customers (ACME & BrightNova) completed Dedicated onboarding in pilot zone without data incidents.

Risks
- Model throughput regression on long-context chat cases after the recent runtime change; affects throughput on Reserved pools under burst traffic. Engineering triage started this morning (see attachment).
- QBR ask from Acme procurement for a firm SLA with specific audit windows; legal needs a read for feasibility.

Asks (short, actionable)
- Laura: confirm whether we can commit to a 99.9% monthly uptime SLA for Dedicated by Friday EOD.
- Tessa: prioritise the throughput regression P0 debug and provide ETA for mitigation (can we have an initial update by 1pm PST?).
- Vivek/Grace: prioritize a single-slide summary for Thursday that lists the win, the risk with mitigation plan, and any customer impact. I attached the current one-pager for edits.

Attachments: QBR_onepager_v2.pdf (one-pager snapshot)

Thanks —
Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Exec Leadership <leadership-distro@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 QBR prep: quick pulse — wins, risks, asks

On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 09:12 Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Team — sending a short pulse to capture items we should surface in Thursday's QBR.

Thanks Markus — a couple of quick notes:
- On the SLA: legal flagged that 99.9% is possible but we need to carve out scheduled maintenance windows for Dedicated customers; I'll sync with Legal and send a short summary by EOD Friday.
- For the ACME ask, I recommend we offer a 30-day pilot SLA addendum (contractual) while engineering completes the throughput work. That should be acceptable to procurement as an interim measure.

I also want to call out a positive: Support volume for basic Hosted API onboarding dropped 22% this quarter, which is a good signal for DX improvements. Could be a one-liner in the wins slide.

Laura Bennett
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Exec Leadership <leadership-distro@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 13:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 QBR prep: quick pulse — wins, risks, asks

Markus — quick operational update from infra:
- Triage found that a kernel fallback path introduced increased memory pressure for long-sequence KV cache entries; reproduced in staging. Root cause fix ready (commit + canary) but we need to roll carefully — expected rollout window 2 hours.
- Mitigation plan: revert fallback, deploy optimized kernel, canary 10% Dedicated traffic, monitor 2 hours, then full rollout. Estimated full mitigation by 17:00 PST today if no regression in canary.

Attached: throughput-metrics.csv (sample metrics from the failing window).

I'll post a one-line status for the QBR once canary starts.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@acme-analytics.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 QBR prep: quick pulse — wins, risks, asks

Markus/Laura — thanks for the update and for surfacing the throughput work. From Acme's side:
- We're happy to accept a 30-day pilot SLA addendum while engineering completes mitigation, provided we get a dated timeline and an audit window.
- Can you confirm who will own the signed addendum on Redwood's side and share a draft (we can take it to procurement).

We'd also like a short sync (15 minutes) tomorrow to finalize the wording. Available windows: 10:00–10:30am PST or 2:00–2:30pm PST.

Attachment: acme_sla_request.docx (procurement's template)

Regards,
Maya Patel
Head of Procurement
Acme Analytics
